identityDimensions.name: contentIdentity
identityDimensions.meaning: The repository tree and every non-platform input that can change the command result: toolchain, command contract, relevant environment, and declared input set.

identityDimensions.name: provenanceIdentity
identityDimensions.meaning: The immutable commit and its separately observed branch, tag, or commit reference resolution for the same tree.

identityDimensions.name: platformIdentity
identityDimensions.meaning: The operating-system, architecture, and exact platform inputs relevant to the claim.

identityDimensions.name: artifactIdentity
identityDimensions.meaning: The generated artifact bytes and build contract bound to their release commit and tree.

identityDimensions.name: deploymentIdentity
identityDimensions.meaning: The immutable deployment and environment bound to the exact source tree and artifact digest it serves.

claimContracts.note: Local and hosted Full are alternatives when they prove this same claim with identical required identities.
Commit, branch, or tag provenance is checked independently from tree-addressed behavior evidence.
Hosted Full must bind the landed commit and tree for each claimed platform.
Artifact proof binds release provenance and bytes without requiring another Full when tree verification remains reusable.
Deployment evidence proves the served artifact and environment, not source behavior that it did not execute.

invalidationRule: A changed actual input invalidates only evidence whose policy-required identity includes that changed dimension.
